spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.winners_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N), (∀ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases ↔ M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases x ∧ ∀ y : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases y → ¬ M7.Selection.better q.order (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases y) (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases x)) ∧ (M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases = ∅ ↔ ¬ ∃ x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases x)
spec.guidance: Instantiate Selection.selector_exact over the whole Fin H × actual Record domain. Competitors range over every class and action, never only the current base orbit. Simplify univ membership and feasibleSet emptiness. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.strict_dominator
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases x → x ∉ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases → ∃ y ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases, M7.Selection.better q.order (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases y) (M7.GlobalQuery.objective q bases x)
spec.guidance: Instantiate Selection.selector_strict_dominator for the full finite product domain and literal DefaultQuery predicates. Pareto/lex order laws are already accepted. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.winning_classes
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (i : Fin H), i ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winningClasses q bases ↔ ∃ g : M7.Action.Record N, (i,g) ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases
spec.guidance: Unfold winningClasses and use Finset.mem_image; product extensionality converts the first component equality. Keep every tied class. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.winning_fiber
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (x y : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), x.1 = y.1 → M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases x = M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases y → (x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases ↔ y ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases)
spec.guidance: Use winners_exact. Same class index and actual image make concrete feasible and objective equal; global competitors are identical. Do not assume class-label invariance for different images. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.presentation_sound
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), M7.GlobalQuery.present q bases x → x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases ∧ ∀ g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.Action.act g (bases x.1) = M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases x → M7.ActualPresentation.encode x.2 ≤ M7.ActualPresentation.encode g
spec.guidance: Unfold present and apply the some direction of verified ActualPresentation.leastAction_spec. The winner is global; the least-preimage search is within its one structural class. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.same_class_presentation
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N) (x : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N), x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases → ∃! g : M7.Action.Record N, M7.GlobalQuery.present q bases (x.1,g) ∧ M7.Action.act g (bases x.1) = M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases x
spec.guidance: Apply verified leastAction_spec to target realize bases x. Its none alternative is impossible because x.2 is a preimage. The some candidate is globally winning by winning_fiber. Any other presented preimage has the same leastAction value, hence identical action. Do not substitute per-class optima. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.physical_presentation
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N), M7.GlobalQuery.separated bases → ∀ x ∈ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases, ∃! y : M7.GlobalQuery.Index H N, M7.GlobalQuery.present q bases y ∧ M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases y = M7.GlobalQuery.realize bases x
spec.guidance: Use same_class_presentation. The explicit intermediate separated property forces any competing same-image record to have x.1 as its class index. Then uniqueness of the action supplies product equality. This hypothesis will be discharged by actual canonical-generation closure at the final root, not assumed there. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.empty_objectives
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N), q.objectives = [] → M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases = M7.Selection.feasibleSet Finset.univ (M7.GlobalQuery.feasible q bases)
spec.guidance: Instantiate accepted Selection.empty_objectives after destructuring/replacing Query.objectives so its dependent Fin length is zero. Keep all global feasible indices. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.

metadata.source_section: M7 original §8/9 global classes/actions and distinct physical ties

spec.name: M7.GlobalQuery.invalid_rejection
spec.statement: ∀ (H N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (bases : M7.GlobalQuery.Family H N), (¬ M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q → M7.GlobalQuery.answer q bases = Except.error M7.DefaultQuery.QueryError.invalidSignature ∧ M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases = ∅) ∧ (M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q → M7.GlobalQuery.answer q bases = Except.ok (M7.GlobalQuery.winners q bases))
spec.guidance: Unfold answer for the error/ok branch. For empty winners use winners_exact and the valid conjunct of actual DefaultQuery.feasible. Invalid signatures are rejected, distinct from a legal empty global answer. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve frozen target and default limits.
